# Stop Biting
> An app that uses on-device AI (MediaPipe/WebAssembly) to detect nail biting (onychophagia) in real-time via webcam, then sounds an alarm. 100% private — no camera data ever leaves your device. Available as a native desktop app for Mac and Windows, and as a web app (PWA).

- [Mindfulness for Nail Biting: Useful, Oversold, and Frequently Misapplied](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-mindfulness): Mindfulness genuinely targets the awareness gap that keeps nail biting automatic — but only if applied to the habit itself rather than to general stress.
- [Trigger Mapping: Find Out When You Actually Bite Your Nails](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-trigger-mapping): Most people are wrong about when they bite their nails.
- [Habit Stacking for Nail Biting: Attaching New Responses to Existing Cues](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-habit-stacking): Habit stacking works well for building new routines, but nail biting needs a specific variant.
- [Using an Accountability Partner to Stop Nail Biting](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-accountability-partner): Social support is a formal component of habit reversal training and the one most people skip.
- [A Nail Care Routine Built for People Who Bite](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-care-routine-for-nail-biters): Standard nail care advice assumes nails you are growing out.
- [Do Gloves Stop Nail Biting? An Honest Assessment](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-gloves): Gloves and finger covers are the most-suggested physical barrier for nail biting.
- [Tape, Plasters and Finger Covers for Nail Biting](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-finger-tape): Taping target fingers is cheap, discreet, and more sustainable than gloves.
- [Does Regular Nail Polish Help You Stop Biting?](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-regular-nail-polish): Ordinary nail polish has no bitter agent and no real barrier, yet many biters report it helps.
- [Why Punishing a Child for Nail Biting Backfires](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-punishing-children): Telling off, shaming, and punishing a child for nail biting reliably makes it worse.
- [Nail Biting vs Cheek and Lip Biting: Same Family, Different Problems](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-vs-cheek-biting): Cheek and lip biting share drivers with nail biting and frequently substitute for it.
- [Nail Biting vs Teeth Grinding: Two Habits, One Jaw](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-vs-teeth-grinding): Nail biting and bruxism share drivers and frequently occur together.
- [How Accurate Is AI Nail Biting Detection? A Straight Answer](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-detection-accuracy): What webcam-based nail biting detection can and cannot reliably catch, why false positives happen, and how the trade-off is actually tuned.
- [Getting Your Camera Setup Right for Nail Biting Detection](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-camera-setup): Detection quality depends more on lighting and camera angle than on hardware.
- [Does Running Nail Biting Detection Slow Down Your Computer?](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-app-battery-performance): Running AI detection all day raises fair questions about CPU load and battery life.
- [How to Choose a Nail Biting Treatment: A Decision Framework](https://stopbiting.today/blog/how-to-choose-nail-biting-treatment): Rankings tell you what works on average.
- [The 5 Biggest Mistakes People Make When Trying to Stop Nail Biting](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-mistakes): Most failed attempts at stopping nail biting fail in the same five ways.
- [Nail Biting at the Gym and During Sports: What Helps and What Backfires](https://stopbiting.today/blog/nail-biting-gym-sports): Almost nobody bites their nails mid-workout — the risk sits either side of it.

## Key facts

- Nail biting (onychophagia) affects 20–30% of adults and up to 45% of adolescents
- Habit Reversal Training (HRT) reduces biting frequency by 70–90% in consistent practitioners (Cochrane review, 2012)
- BFRBs (body-focused repetitive behaviors) are classified in the DSM-5 under OCD-related disorders
- Stop Biting uses MediaPipe running in WebAssembly — zero network requests during detection
- Detection works fully offline after initial load; no camera data is transmitted or stored
- The app detects nail biting using hand landmark (21 keypoints) + face mesh (468 landmarks) models
- Free 3-day trial — available for macOS 12+, Windows 10+, and in the browser as a PWA
- On-device AI: camera feed never leaves the device — independently verifiable via network monitoring
